outreach_subject: A website concept for How Sweet Bakery in Johor Bahru
outreach_text:
Hello How Sweet Bakery,

I'm Amala from MultiMax. We build affordable websites for local businesses. I found your Johor Bahru bakery through public listings and your Facebook page, along with this publicly listed business email. I did not identify a dedicated official website in the sources I checked.

I prepared an independent website concept for How Sweet Bakery, introducing your custom cakes, wedding cakes and full moon cakes with an easy way for customers to find your contact details. It is clearly labelled as an unsolicited concept, not your official website. The cake photo is illustrative stock, not a photo of your products. Two current screenshots of the live preview are attached.

Live preview:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/websites/how-sweet-bakery-johor/

Website source:
https://github.com/amalraj020-a11y/10am-office-work/tree/c67f1af5c85c7356596dcec79d8ad3d962082424/websites/how-sweet-bakery-johor

Desktop screenshot:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/how-sweet-bakery-johor-desktop.png

Mobile screenshot:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/how-sweet-bakery-johor-mobile.png

If this would be useful, reply and we can discuss your own photos, current details and a small agreed budget. Backend or database features would be optional later work, not part of this static preview. There is no obligation. If you prefer no further contact, let me know and I will respect that.

Amala
MultiMax
